speaker: god
text: Yet even now,
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: return to Me with all your heart, with fasting, weeping, and mourning.
name: The LORD

speaker: priests
text: Spare Your people, O LORD, and do not make Your heritage a reproach, an object of scorn among the nations. Why should they say among the peoples, ‘Where is their God?’
name: The priests

speaker: god
text: Behold, I will send you grain, new wine, and oil, and by them you will be satisfied. I will never again make you a reproach among the nations.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: The northern army I will drive away from you, banishing it to a barren and desolate land, its front ranks into the Eastern Sea, and its rear guard into the Western Sea. And its stench will rise; its foul odor will ascend. For He has done great things.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Do not be afraid, O land; rejoice and be glad, for the LORD has done great things.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Do not be afraid, O beasts of the field, for the open pastures have turned green, the trees bear their fruit, and the fig tree and vine yield their best.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Be glad, O children of Zion, and rejoice in the LORD your God, for He has given you the autumn rains for your vindication. He sends you showers, both autumn and spring rains, as before.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: The threshing floors will be full of grain, and the vats will overflow with new wine and oil.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: I will repay you for the years eaten by locusts— the swarming locust, the young locust, the destroying locust, and the devouring locust— My great army that I sent against you.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: You will have plenty to eat, until you are satisfied. You will praise the name of the LORD your God, who has worked wonders for you. My people will never again be put to shame.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Then you will know that I am present in Israel and that I am the LORD your God, and there is no other. My people will never again be put to shame.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: And afterward, I will pour out My Spirit on all people. Your sons and daughters will prophesy, your old men will dream dreams, your young men will see visions.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Even on My menservants and maidservants, I will pour out My Spirit in those days.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: I will show wonders in the heavens and on the earth, blood and fire and columns of smoke.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: The sun will be turned to darkness and the moon to blood before the coming of the great and awesome Day of the LORD.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: And everyone who calls on the name of the LORD will be saved; for on Mount Zion and in Jerusalem there will be deliverance, as the LORD has promised, among the remnant called by the LORD.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Yes, in those days and at that time, when I restore Judah and Jerusalem from captivity,
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: I will gather all the nations and bring them down to the Valley of Jehoshaphat. There I will enter into judgment against them concerning My people, My inheritance, Israel, whom they have scattered among the nations as they divided up My land.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: They cast lots for My people; they bartered a boy for a prostitute and sold a girl for wine to drink.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Now what do you have against Me, O Tyre, Sidon, and all the regions of Philistia? Are you rendering against Me a recompense? If you retaliate against Me, I will swiftly and speedily return your recompense upon your heads.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: For you took My silver and gold and carried off My finest treasures to your temples.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: You sold the people of Judah and Jerusalem to the Greeks, to send them far from their homeland.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Behold, I will rouse them from the places to which you sold them; I will return your recompense upon your heads.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: I will sell your sons and daughters into the hands of the people of Judah, and they will sell them to the Sabeans—to a distant nation.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Prepare for war; rouse the mighty men; let all the men of war advance and attack!
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Beat your plowshares into swords and your pruning hooks into spears. Let the weak say, ‘I am strong!’
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Come quickly, all you surrounding nations, and gather yourselves. Bring down Your mighty ones, O LORD.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Let the nations be roused and advance to the Valley of Jehoshaphat, for there I will sit down to judge all the nations on every side.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Swing the sickle, for the harvest is ripe. Come, trample the grapes, for the winepress is full; the wine vats overflow because their wickedness is great.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Multitudes, multitudes in the valley of decision! For the Day of the LORD is near in the valley of decision.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: The sun and moon will grow dark, and the stars will no longer shine.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: The LORD will roar from Zion and raise His voice from Jerusalem; heaven and earth will tremble. But the LORD will be a refuge for His people, a stronghold for the people of Israel.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Then you will know that I am the LORD your God, who dwells in Zion, My holy mountain. Jerusalem will be holy, never again to be overrun by foreigners.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: And in that day the mountains will drip with sweet wine, and the hills will flow with milk. All the streams of Judah will run with water, and a spring will flow from the house of the LORD to water the Valley of Acacias.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Egypt will become desolate, and Edom a desert wasteland, because of the violence done to the people of Judah, in whose land they shed innocent blood.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: But Judah will be inhabited forever, and Jerusalem from generation to generation.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: For I will avenge their blood, which I have not yet avenged.
name: The LORD
